channel.title: Booked: First Day In
channel.desc: In Mesa County, a man is busted by deputies after his own mother turns him in; in Virginia Beach, a father of five owns up to driving without a license, while a woman spends her first night in jail over a photo album; in Modesto, a cigarette run ends with a man hauled in on misdemeanor warrants, and a young and reckless driver is arrested when officers uncover a stash of drugs in the car.
